en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
Drinking green tea after a meal
Sleeping after a meal
Exercising after a meal

Oh, no...
I had assumed you preferred black tea...

For me to make such a simple error...
I have failed as a maid...
I do not care how you berate me...
As a maid, I have made such a grave mistake.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't think it's *that*
much of a mistake...
May I monitor your sleeping environment?

Depending on the time of day, the quality of
your sleep may change. We can adjust that.

It is fine... I do not think it is troublesome
at all.

To serve you so that you may receive the most
fruitful results... That is my happiness.

Then allow me to schedule an exercise
regimen for you.

I will create a routine that will not disturb
your digestion.

In a month's time, you will become a
more reliable detective.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
